select cls, cast(fished_date_doy/10 as int)*10 as doy_bucket, round(sum(yt)/sum(anglers),3) as ypa, count(*) n
from trips
where fished_date_season=6 and fished_date_doy between 110 and 152 and cls in ('THREE_QUARTER','DAY_1_5','OVERNIGHT')
group by 1,2
order by 1,2

select cls, cast(fish_date_doy/10 as int)*10 as doy_bucket, round(sum(yt)/sum(anglers),3) as ypa, count(*) n
from trips
where fish_date_season=6 and fish_date_doy between 110 and 152 and cls in ('three_quarter','day_1_5','overnight')
group by 1,2
order by 1,2
